Two adjacent surface strips; reverse camera. Outer parts of the approach and temporary-control zone are not represented.

geometry_checks.calibration: Relative pixel-width review heuristics within one satellite image, not meter-based standards.

far_upstream.note: In this pilot, in_* means the stopbar approach. Far-upstream link cross-sections are separate and must not be equated to stopbar counts.
